basic_details.job_title: Kerala University Casual Conductor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Update 23 Nov 2026: Online application open again till 07 December 2026 (5.00 PM). Kerala University issued a new notification dated 21.11.2026 for the same post, and it asks for a valid Conductor Licence.

how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://recruit.keralauniversity.ac.in/homePage.
Register and log in with a valid E-mail ID.
Fill out the online application form and upload the required certificates and documents.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 250 for General candidates or Rs. 125 for SC/ST candidates through online payment mode only.
Submit the online application before 5.00 PM on 07 December 2026. Do not send the hard copy to the university.
For more details, contact phone 0471-2386209 or e-mail [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following eligibility conditions to apply for the Casual Conductor position: Educational Qualification: SSLC / Secondary or equivalent qualification. Technical Qualification: Valid Conductor Licence approved by the Motor Vehicles Department. Age Limit: Must not exceed 40 years as of 01.01.2026. Age relaxations apply to SC/ST and OBC candidates as per prevailing government rules. Physical Standards: Minimum height of 158 cm and minimum chest girth of 76 cm. Candidates with physical disabilities are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala University Casual Conductor
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://recruit.keralauniversity.ac.in/homePage . Register and log in with a valid E-mail ID. Fill out the online application form and upload the required certificates and documents. Pay the application fee of Rs. 250 for General candidates or Rs. 125 for SC/ST candidates through online payment mode only. Submit the online application before 5.00 PM on 07 December 2026. Do not send the hard copy to the university. For more details, contact phone 0471-2386209 or e-mail [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection involves preparing a panel of candidates through an online application process, followed by verification of physical standards, a physical fitness test (including eye test) certified by a medical officer not below the rank of Assistant Civil Surgeon in Government Medical Dispensaries, and subsequent selection stages such as a driving test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kerala University Casual Conductors Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 07 December 2026 by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Casual Conductors post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC or equivalent and possess a valid Conductor Licence approved by the Motor Vehicles Department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the daily wage offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a daily wage of Rs. 710 per day, subject to a monthly maximum of Rs. 19,170.

faq.question: Q4. Is this appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary on a daily wage basis for 89 days, and selected candidates do not have any claim to regular employment, pension, or reappointment.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable to SC/ST and OBC candidates as per the prevailing rules of the university and government norms.
